column1: # Paste each snippet into a Divi **Code module** (not a Text module — Text mangles iframes and scripts). Per page, in the Divi builder: Row > Design > Sizing > Width 100% and Max Width `none` (the literal word none, not 100%); Section > Design > Spacing > padding 0 top and bottom; Row > Design > Spacing > padding 0 top and bottom. A Divi 5 row ships at width 80% / max-width 1080px, so an untouched embed renders in a narrow column and every full-bleed colour band collapses with it. After any CSS change, clear Divi's static CSS cache: Divi > Theme Options > Builder > Advanced > Clear.

# The height in each snippet is only a STARTING value, shown for the moment before the page posts its real height and the listener applies it. The values below were measured at 1440px wide on 2026-09-23; mobile is taller and corrects itself on load. A seed that is far off shows as a brief gap or a brief clip, nothing worse.

# KEEP scrolling="no" ON EVERY IFRAME. Without it, an embedded page that has even a few pixels it could scroll will swallow the visitor's wheel events, and the outer page then only scrolls when the cursor is over its scrollbar. The pages are also built so they have no scroll room of their own (see the trailing-margin guard in each repo's CSS), but this attribute is the cheap second line of defence and costs nothing.
